package echo

import (
    "context"
    "encoding/json"
    "strings"
    "testing"

    "github.com/Cyenoch/cordis/contract"
    "github.com/Cyenoch/cordis/schema"
)

type localScope struct { handler contract.Handler }
func (s *localScope) Provide(service contract.Service,handler contract.Handler) error {
    if service.Name != "example.echo" || service.Major != 1 { return contract.Fail(contract.Invalid,"wrong service registration") }
    s.handler = handler
    return nil
}
func (s *localScope) Call(ctx context.Context,requirement contract.Requirement,input json.RawMessage) (json.RawMessage,error) {
    if requirement.Name != "example.echo" || requirement.Major != 1 { return nil,contract.Fail(contract.Invalid,"wrong requirement") }
    return s.handler(ctx,input)
}

type implementation struct{}
func (implementation) Echo(ctx context.Context,input ExampleEchoEchoRequest) (ExampleEchoEchoResponse,error) {
    repeat := 1
    if input.Repeat.Present { repeat = int(input.Repeat.Value) }
    return ExampleEchoEchoResponse{Text:ExampleEchoEchoResponseText(strings.Repeat(string(input.Text),repeat)),Sequence:ExampleEchoEchoResponseSequence(input.Sequence)},nil
}
func (implementation) Choose(ctx context.Context,input ExampleEchoChooseRequest) (ExampleEchoChooseResponse,error) {
    if input.VariantText.Present { return ExampleEchoChooseResponse{ExampleEchoChooseResponseItem(input.VariantText.Value.Text)},nil }
    return ExampleEchoChooseResponse{},nil
}

func TestGeneratedTypedRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
    scope := &localScope{}
    if err := RegisterExampleEchoServer(scope,implementation{}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    client := NewExampleEchoClient(scope)
    input := ExampleEchoEchoRequest{
        Text: "hi",
        Sequence: ExampleEchoEchoRequestSequence(9223372036854775807),
        Payload: ExampleEchoEchoRequestPayload([]byte("bytes")),
        Note: ExampleEchoEchoRequestNote{Nullable:schema.Nullable[ExampleEchoEchoRequestNoteValue]{}},
        Repeat:schema.Some(ExampleEchoEchoRequestRepeat(2)),
    }
    response,err := client.Echo(context.Background(),input)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if response.Text != "hihi" || response.Sequence != 9223372036854775807 { t.Fatalf("wrong response: %+v",response) }
    encoded,err := json.Marshal(input)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    var wire map[string]json.RawMessage
    if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded,&wire); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if string(wire["sequence"]) != `"9223372036854775807"` || string(wire["note"]) != "null" || string(wire["payload"]) != `"Ynl0ZXM="` { t.Fatalf("wrong wire data: %s",encoded) }
    var decoded ExampleEchoEchoRequest
    if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded,&decoded); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if !decoded.Repeat.Present || decoded.Repeat.Value != 2 || decoded.Note.Valid { t.Fatalf("presence/null lost: %+v",decoded) }
    input.Repeat = schema.Optional[ExampleEchoEchoRequestRepeat]{}
    encoded,err = json.Marshal(input)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    wire = nil
    if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded,&wire); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if _,exists := wire["repeat"]; exists { t.Fatal("absent optional field was serialized") }
    input.Repeat = schema.Some(ExampleEchoEchoRequestRepeat(0))
    if _,err := client.Echo(context.Background(),input); err == nil { t.Fatal("client sent invalid range") }
}

func TestGeneratedUnionAndStrictServer(t *testing.T) {
    scope := &localScope{}
    if err := RegisterExampleEchoServer(scope,implementation{}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    client := NewExampleEchoClient(scope)
    var input ExampleEchoChooseRequest
    if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"kind":"text","text":"chosen"}`),&input); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    response,err := client.Choose(context.Background(),input)
    if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    if len(response) != 1 || response[0] != "chosen" { t.Fatalf("wrong union response: %v",response) }
    if _,err := json.Marshal(ExampleEchoChooseRequest{}); err == nil { t.Fatal("empty union encoded") }
    for _,raw := range []string{
        `{"method":"choose","input":{"kind":"text","text":"x"},"extra":true}`,
        `{"method":"choose","input":{"kind":"other"}}`,
        `{"method":"choose","input":{"kind":"text","text":"x","extra":true}}`,
        `{"method":"unknown","input":{}}`,
        `{"method":"echo"}`,
    } {
        if _,err := scope.handler(context.Background(),json.RawMessage(raw)); err == nil { t.Fatalf("invalid envelope accepted: %s",raw) }
    }
}
